leadText:
Ivan (Japanese: ショウタ Shōta) is a character of the day who appeared in A Poké-BLOCK Party!.

Ivan won the Trick House challenge in his hometown, Mauville City, and was rewarded for this by the Trick Master. He struggled to hold up the year supply of Pokéblock and toppled over because of the weight, as and Alanna watched and giggled. Later, took to the stage and to the audience, making everyone fall including Ivan.
